latest_manifest.name: RuneForged
latest_manifest.description:
This mod brings RuneScape into Chivalry II, featuring 98 weapon skin replacements with RuneScape weapons/variants.

Wanted a Godsword? It's there. Granite Maul? It's there. Every weapon features at least 1 skin from RuneScape, some have several.
